title: Borland on stage will neither confirm nor deny Project Rubik's Cube

tellings.quote: I can neither confirm nor deny that if you want me to answer that back question, ask for a damn receipt for the whistleblowers.

plain: At a live stage event, Dylan Borland, a man the show presents as a whistleblower, was asked about Project Rubik's Cube, a reported secret programme, and would neither confirm nor deny it. Borland describes the moment himself on an episode with the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell: "I can neither confirm nor deny," he says, and he adds that people should "ask for a damn receipt for the whistleblowers."
